input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves Customer, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including sms model, base entity, data entity, status. The platform provides capabilities for refactor cart, refactor user, cart application. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage sms model records, so that I can track and organize sms model data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage base entity records, so that I can track and organize base entity data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage data entity records, so that I can track and organize data entity data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage status records, so that I can track and organize status data effectively.
